title: MEDIA TIKTOK 666
description: A professional movie and series streaming and download website with a poster grid, star ratings, view counts, bookmarks, watch history, VIP-locked posts, responsive banner ads and emoji-reaction comments for logged-in users.

pages.name: Home
pages.title: Beranda
pages.info: The home page of a dark cinematic streaming site. Section 1: a full-bleed featured-movie hero slider (3 slides from the newest Movie records) with backdrop image, oversized Bebas Neue title, star rating, view count, genre chips and two buttons 'Tonton Sekarang' (links to /watch?id=...) and a bookmark heart toggle; slides have back/next arrow buttons. Section 2: a responsive horizontal banner ad slot (AdBanner where placement = home_top and isActive = true), 728x90 on desktop, 320x100 on mobile, labelled 'Iklan'. Section 3: 'Terakhir Dilihat' – a horizontal scroll row of the logged-in user's latest WatchHistory records (poster, title, episode number, a thin progress bar); hidden for guests with a small prompt to log in. Section 4: 'Postingan Terbaru' – the main poster grid (2 columns mobile, 3 tablet, 5-6 desktop) of Movie records sorted by publishedAt, each card showing thumbnail, title, year, genre, gold star rating (e.g. 8.4), eye icon with view count (e.g. 12.5K), a 'Series'/'Film' badge, a bookmark icon button, and a gold lock badge 'VIP' when isVipOnly is true; filter chips above the grid by genre (Aksi, Drama, Horor, Komedi, Romantis, Anime) and by type, plus a search box; pagination with 'Sebelumnya' and 'Selanjutnya' buttons. Section 5: a mid-grid banner ad (placement = home_middle). Section 6: 'Daftar Judul A–Z' – a compact alphabetical title list with letter tabs. Section 7: a VIP band with a gold gradient: 'Gabung Member VIP – tanpa iklan, akses film terkunci, download HD', with a 'Join Member VIP' button that opens a 'Segera hadir – hubungi kami' modal. Header has the 'Masuk / Daftar' button and a 'Bookmark' link that opens a drawer listing the user's Bookmark records.

seo.title: MEDIA TIKTOK 666 – Streaming & Download Film
seo.description: Nonton dan download film serta series terbaru dengan rating, jumlah view, bookmark dan akses VIP di MEDIA TIKTOK 666.

pages.name: Watch
pages.title: Streaming & Download
pages.info: The dedicated streaming and download page for one Movie, loaded by id from the URL. Section 1: a 16:9 video player with dark frame; if the movie isVipOnly and the user is not a VIP (role 2), the player is replaced by a blurred backdrop with a gold lock icon, 'Konten Khusus Member VIP' and a 'Join Member VIP' button (opens a 'Segera hadir – hubungi kami' modal). On open, a WatchHistory record is saved for the logged-in user. Section 2: an episode bar for series – numbered Episode chips plus 'Episode Sebelumnya' and 'Episode Selanjutnya' navigation buttons; for films, back/next go to the previous/next movie. Section 3: title, year, genre, gold star rating, view count, bookmark toggle button ('Tambah ke Bookmark' / 'Tersimpan') and a synopsis. Section 4: a download box with buttons per quality (360p, 720p, 1080p from the download URLs), HD links locked for non-VIP. Section 5: a responsive banner ad (AdBanner placement = watch_below_player), 728x90 desktop and 320x100 mobile. Section 6: modern comment section – a count heading 'Komentar (24)', a rounded input with avatar that is disabled for guests and shows 'Masuk dengan Google atau Facebook untuk berkomentar'; each Comment card shows avatar, name, relative time, body, and an emoji reaction bar (👍 ❤️ 😂 😮 😢 🔥) with counts from CommentReaction, where logged-in users can toggle one reaction. Section 7: a sidebar (bottom on mobile) with a square ad (placement = watch_sidebar) and 'Rekomendasi' – 8 poster cards of the same genre.

seo.title: Nonton & Download – MEDIA TIKTOK 666
seo.description: Streaming dan download film atau series favoritmu dalam kualitas HD, lengkap dengan episode, komentar dan bookmark.

pages.name: Login
pages.title: Masuk / Daftar
pages.info: A full-screen split layout: on desktop the left half is a dark collage of blurred movie posters with the MEDIA TIKTOK 666 wordmark and the line 'Simpan bookmark, lanjutkan tontonan, dan ikut berkomentar'; the right half is a glassy card. The card has a sign in / sign up switch at the top. Primary actions are two large buttons 'Lanjutkan dengan Google' and 'Lanjutkan dengan Facebook' with brand icons, then an 'atau' divider and an email + password form (plus full name on sign up). Below: a small note that VIP membership is available after login. After login the user returns to the page they came from. On mobile the poster collage becomes a short top banner.

seo.title: Masuk atau Daftar – MEDIA TIKTOK 666
seo.description: Masuk dengan Google atau Facebook untuk menyimpan bookmark, riwayat tontonan dan berkomentar.

design.concept: A near-black, poster-first streaming hub that feels like walking into a late-night cinema lit by neon signage. Posters do the talking; chrome stays quiet. A hot magenta-red accent drives actions, and gold is reserved strictly for ratings and VIP so premium always reads instantly.
design.layout: Transparent top bar over a full-bleed hero slider that turns into a solid blurred bar on scroll; below, a wide contained content area with stacked rows and a dense poster grid. On the Watch page, a two-column layout: player and content on the left, ads and recommendations in a sticky right sidebar that drops below on mobile.
design.nav: Left: the wordmark 'MEDIA TIKTOK 666' in Bebas Neue with the '666' in accent color. Center: Beranda, Film, Series, Genre links with an underline glow on active. Right: search icon that expands into a field, bookmark icon with count badge, a gold outlined 'VIP' pill button, and 'Masuk' button or user avatar. Mobile: a fixed bottom tab bar (Beranda, Cari, Bookmark, Akun) plus a side drawer for genres.
design.hero: Full-bleed backdrop of the featured movie with a bottom-to-top black gradient, a giant condensed title, star rating, view count, genre chips, 'Tonton Sekarang' accent button and bookmark toggle; circular back/next arrows and dot indicators for 3 slides.
design.sections: Hero (full-bleed) → thin banner ad strip → 'Terakhir Dilihat' horizontal row → genre filter chips → large poster grid → mid-grid ad → A–Z title list → gold VIP band (full-bleed) → footer with genres and disclaimer. Dark sections alternate with slightly lighter panel bands to separate rows.
design.typography: Bebas Neue for oversized headings and section titles with wide tracking, small uppercase eyebrows in the accent color; Plus Jakarta Sans for everything else at compact sizes for dense metadata.
design.shapes: Posters at 2:3 with 10px corners and a subtle inner border; cards lift with a soft glow shadow on hover; pill-shaped chips and buttons; hairline dividers in low-opacity white; glassy panels with backdrop blur for modals and the comment box.
design.imagery: Poster thumbnails everywhere, full-bleed backdrops with heavy gradient overlays, blurred poster collages behind locked VIP content and on the login page.
design.motion: Fade-up on scroll for rows, poster hover scale 1.04 with a play icon fading in, a slow marquee of trending titles under the hero, emoji pop animation when a reaction is tapped.
design.signature: A glowing neon '666' badge and a running ticker marquee of 'Sedang Trending' titles in condensed uppercase type, plus gold lock ribbons diagonally across VIP posters.
